subtitle: Cacisa izimpawu ezihlangene
short_description: Xazulula amasamba ahlangene ngesihloli esicacile seseli.
description: Gcwalisa umugqa ngamunye we-Kakuro ngamadijithi angu-1 kuya ku-9 ukuze isamba sihambisane nesimpawu; ungaphindi idijithi phakathi komugqa. Xazulula amabhodi amasha angu-8 e-5×5 ukuze uvule elilandelayo. Isihloli se-Compass sikhombisa amasamba okuqondile nawokuphansi kanye namadijithi atholakala ngokwasendaweni ngeseli ekhethiwe. Ukuhlehlisa, ukusula, ukuqala kabusha, nenqubekelaphambili yasendaweni kufakiwe.
